tool.name: gatk4_svannotate
tool.description: Adds predicted functional consequence, gene overlap, and noncoding element overlap annotations to SV VCF from GATK-SV pipeline. Input files are an SV VCF, a GTF file containing primary or canonical transcripts, and a BED file containing noncoding elements. Output file is an annotated SV VCF.

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**gatk4_svannotate**
Adds predicted functional consequence, gene overlap, and noncoding element overlap annotations to SV VCF from GATK-SV pipeline. Input files are an SV VCF, a GTF file containing primary or canonical transcripts, and a BED file containing noncoding elements. Output file is an annotated SV VCF.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: gatk4/svannotate - Container: biocontainers/gatk4:4.6.2.0
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
